text:
Alex M.: hey folks, first day on infra team — quick org question: who owns VPC/network access requests and the escalation path for network incidents?
Maria P.: welcome! ping @chen for VPC/network stuff, he owns infra-network. :wave:
Chen (infra): yup that's me. For new hires: 1) fill the infra access form (https://internal.redwood/vpc-access), 2) attach your SSH pubkey, 3) get manager approval. For urgent network incidents page #eng-oncall and escalate to infra-pager.
Alex M.: thanks — do new hires get oncall right away or start read-only?
oncall-bot: Reminder: new-hires default to read-only. To join rotations complete the pager training and onboarding checklist. Use `/oncall signup` after training.
Sam K.: also note the ownership map is in the internal handbook (Engineering -> Ownership). Quick pointers: model-serving = eng-runtime (Sam/Runtime), billing = finance (Maria), infra rollouts = eng-platform. I can drop links if helpful.
Alex M.: super. Can someone point me to a concise "who to ask" map for first-week tasks (access, billing, deploys, model-serving)?
Lena - People Ops: we have a 1-pager in the new-hire kit, DM'ing now. Also cc your manager on requests and include ticket IDs.
Chen (infra): tl;dr list: - VPC / network access: @chen / infra-network - Bastion / SSH keys: infra-sec team - Model-serving infra: eng-runtime / @sam - Billing & cost questions: @Maria P. (finance) - Urgent outages: page #eng-oncall then escalate to infra-pager - Non-urgent changes: open infra-requests ticket
Alex M.: perfect, I'll start the form and ping my manager. one more: who owns the dedicated GPU cluster for experiments?
Sam K.: dedicated-capacity team owns that (assigns: Sam K. + Viv). I'll intro you to Viv in DMs. :+1:
Alex M.: great, thanks everyone — this is exactly what I needed.
